parrafo.es: Seasalt Paella Live Catering lleva paella autentica, hecha con arroz de Valencia, directo a tu evento en Miami. El chef llega con todo lo necesario y cocina frente a tus invitados: mariscos, pollo o vegetales, sin que tengas que limpiar ni recoger nada.
parrafo.en: Seasalt Paella Live Catering brings authentic, Valencia-rice paella straight to your event in Miami. The chef arrives with everything needed and cooks right in front of your guests, seafood, chicken or vegetable, with no cleanup left for you.

parrafo_1.es: Seasalt Paella Live Catering se dedica a una sola cosa: paella autentica, cocinada en vivo. El chef trae la paellera, los ingredientes frescos y el arroz de Valencia, y cocina frente a tus invitados mientras responde sus preguntas sobre el proceso.
parrafo_1.en: Seasalt Paella Live Catering does one thing: authentic paella, cooked live. The chef brings the pan, the fresh ingredients and real Valencia rice, and cooks right in front of your guests while answering their questions about the process.

parrafo_2.es: Lo confirman sus clientes: llegan con todo listo, se adaptan al pedido de cada evento y no dejan nada que limpiar. Tu solo pones los platos.
parrafo_2.en: Their clients confirm it: they arrive fully equipped, accommodate each event's requests, and leave nothing to clean up. You just provide the plates.

texto.es: Nos llamas y nos cuentas la fecha, el numero de invitados y el tipo de evento. Respuesta directa, sin formularios.
texto.en: Call us and tell us the date, the guest count and the type of event. Direct answers, no forms.

texto.es: Mariscos, pollo o vegetales: armamos el menu segun lo que tus invitados prefieran.
texto.en: Seafood, chicken or vegetable: we build the menu around what your guests prefer.

texto.es: Llegamos con la paellera, el arroz de Valencia y los ingredientes frescos, y cocinamos frente a todos.
texto.en: We arrive with the pan, real Valencia rice and fresh ingredients, and cook right in front of everyone.

texto.es: Sirves, comes y te vas a disfrutar tu evento. Solo necesitas platos y cubiertos, el resto es nuestro.
texto.en: You serve, eat and get back to your event. You only need plates and silverware, the rest is on us.

nota.es: Cada evento se cotiza según el número de invitados y el menú elegido. Llámanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every event is quoted based on guest count and menu. Call us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Langosta, camarones, mejillones y almejas sobre arroz de Valencia, cocinada frente a tus invitados. El plato que mas piden nuestros clientes.
texto.en: Lobster, shrimp, mussels and clams over real Valencia rice, cooked right in front of your guests. The dish our clients ask for the most.

texto.es: Pollo, vegetales frescos y el mismo arroz de siempre, para eventos con invitados que prefieren algo distinto al marisco.
texto.en: Chicken, fresh vegetables and the same signature rice, for events where guests prefer something other than seafood.

texto.es: Maiz, brocoli, ejotes y pimientos sobre arroz de Valencia, para que nadie en tu evento se quede sin probar la paella.
texto.en: Corn, broccoli, green beans and peppers over Valencia rice, so no one at your event misses out on the paella.

texto.es: Montajes con flores, piña y decoraciones a medida sobre la propia paellera: el plato se vuelve parte de la decoracion de tu evento.
texto.en: Floral touches, pineapple displays and custom garnish right on the pan: the dish becomes part of your event's decor.

pie.es: ¿Tienes un evento con una fecha ajustada? Escríbenos igual, nos hemos adaptado a pedidos de último momento.
pie.en: Working with a tight date? Reach out anyway, we have accommodated last-minute requests before.

items.quote: Best Paella i have ever had, hands down. Fresh ingredients, real valencia rice and the chef was super professional and very nice with my family. They were the most affordable and accommodated all my requests. The chef brought everything and all i had to provide were plates and silverware. No cleaning, no picking up. Highly recommend!

Hired Seasalt for my mothers birthday and i couldn't be happier with the service and quality of the food. The chef was very professional and engaged all the guests with their questions and cooking process. The rice was DELICIOUS!

Best Paellas in town! The staff was knowledgeable, professional and courteous! I hired them for mothers day and my family was very happy and pleased with the food and service. I would definitely hire them again!

Excellent food and service. Second time I host an event with Seasalt. Prices are reasonable and the quality is the best. Authentic valencia rice which has been the best I have tasted. Highly recommended!
